q: What time does normal trading start on NSE and BSE?
w: Pre-open runs 9:00 to 9:15. Normal trading opens at 9:15.

q: When does the market close for the day?
w: Trading ends at 3:30 PM and the close is recorded.

q: An FII is a...
w: FII stands for foreign institutional investor.

q: If the repo rate rises, loans usually become...
w: Banks pay more to borrow, so lending rates tend to rise.

q: A P/E of 25 means you pay about...
w: P/E is price divided by earnings per share.

q: Market cap equals...
w: Market cap is share price times total shares.

q: A SIP means investing...
o: A fixed amount at regular intervals
w: SIP is a regular fixed investment, often monthly.

q: NAV is the price of one...
w: NAV is the value of a single fund unit.

q: In an IPO, a company...
o: Offers shares to the public for the first time
w: IPO means initial public offering.

q: A dividend is...
o: A share of profit paid out
w: Companies may pay part of their profit to shareholders.

q: When bond yields rise, existing bond prices usually...
w: Older, lower-paying bonds become less attractive.

q: A circuit breaker...
o: Pauses trading after a big move
w: It halts trading to cool wild moves.

q: Diversification helps by...
w: It reduces dependence on one stock or sector.

q: ₹1,000 at 10% a year becomes how much after year two with compounding?
w: Year one gives 1,100. Year two adds 10% of 1,100, so 1,210.

q: EPS stands for...
w: EPS is profit divided by number of shares.

q: Which is an index?
w: Nifty 50 tracks 50 large companies.

q: Is a high VIX a prediction of direction?
w: VIX shows the expected size of moves, not direction.

q: Why does costly crude hurt India?
o: India imports most of its oil
w: India imports most of its crude and pays in dollars.

q: A weaker rupee makes imports...
w: More rupees are needed per dollar.

q: Which one is a closing price?
o: The last price of the trading day
The first price of the day
The highest price of the day
w: The close is the final price when trading ends.
